summary: Aggregate: Pydantic model declaring a named numeric column and its accumulation operation (currently 'sum' only).

key_classes.name: Aggregate
key_classes.summary: Two-field Pydantic model: column_name (str) and operation (str, default 'sum'). Passed to AccumulatorEngine to declare numeric accumulation columns.

extension_points: operation field is intended to support 'min', 'max', 'product' — currently only 'sum' is implemented in AccumulatorEngine._expand_level.
documentation_hooks: Document the limitation that only 'sum' is currently operational.
open_questions: No test file dedicated to Aggregate alone — it is exercised via accumulator engine tests.

evidence.detail: Aggregate used to define agg_updates in _expand_level
